positioning.text: Mount Sinai Health System describes itself as an integrated health care system in New York; its mission statement pairs compassionate, coordinated patient care with advancing medicine through education, research and outreach in the diverse communities it serves.
positioning.quote: to advance medicine through unrivaled education, research, and outreach in the many diverse communities we serve.

evidence.title: Mission (Mount Sinai Health System)
evidence.quote: The mission of the Mount Sinai Health System is to provide compassionate patient care with seamless coordination

evidence.title: About the Mount Sinai Health System
evidence.quote: The Mount Sinai Health System is an integrated health care system.

facts.text: Mount Sinai launched the "We Find a Way" brand and advertising campaign in June 2021, describing it as the largest single awareness campaign for the health system, running in national and regional print, television, radio and online media; the campaign landing page still presented "We Find a Way" when opened on 2026-11-10.

evidence.title: "We Find a Way": Mount Sinai Launches National Brand and Advertising Campaign
evidence.quote: national and regional print, television, radio, and online media outlets.

facts.text: In a September 2025 Becker's interview, Mount Sinai's chief marketing and communications officer David A. Feinberg described a recent campaign aimed at the "sandwich generation" of people caring for both young children and elderly parents.

evidence.title: 'Marketing saves lives': Mount Sinai highlights care, research
evidence.quote: One recent marketing campaign focuses on the 'sandwich generation,' the large cohort of Americans, mostly female, caring for both young children and elderly parents.

facts.text: Becker's reported on 2025-09-11 that the health system's app has over 2 million regular users.

facts.text: The MyMountSinai app is presented as the gateway to Mount Sinai physicians, services and medical records, with appointment scheduling, virtual urgent care, virtual primary care and message-only care, and account creation or password reset through CLEAR.

facts.text: A June 2024 Mount Sinai Today post describes a project to raise MyMountSinai usage among Mount Sinai patients in Central Harlem from 54 percent to 70 percent, working with community-based organizations.

facts.text: In August 2026 Mount Sinai announced its 14th year as official health care partner of the US Open Tennis Championships, with a "Play Well, Stay Well" campaign on digital and social channels and an interactive onsite booth where fans can create an animated AI tennis player avatar.

facts.text: On 2024-11-25 Mount Sinai announced the opening of the Hamilton and Amabel James Center for Artificial Intelligence and Human Health, a 12-story, 65,000-square-foot facility, with its dean saying it is one of the first medical schools to establish a dedicated AI research center.

strengths.text: One brand platform, "We Find a Way", runs from the 2021 launch to the campaign page seen in November 2026, which gives the brand a consistent line across years.
The owned content mix is broad for a health system: a blog, four podcasts including a video podcast, and a films section sit alongside seven linked social accounts.
The patient app is a large owned channel, with a published audience figure and virtual care built in.
The US Open partnership is used as a marketing platform with its own campaign name, social activity and an onsite activation, not only as a medical services role.

gaps.text: Mount Sinai's own June 2024 post reports uneven app adoption: MyMountSinai usage among its Central Harlem patients was 54 percent against a stated goal of 70 percent.

opportunitiesForUpmc.text: Mount Sinai's marketing chief cites an app audience number in trade press; UPMC could decide whether publishing a comparable, dated figure for its own app supports its digital story.
Mount Sinai ties app adoption to a named community with a numeric target; a similar neighborhood-level adoption goal would give UPMC a concrete digital equity story to tell.
A recurring video podcast with clinicians is a format UPMC can benchmark its own expert content against.
Sports and event partnerships can carry a named consumer campaign and a digital hook, as the US Open activation does; UPMC's existing sports relationships could be reviewed against that model.
